commands: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml restart postgres redis api worker ui

persistentState.method: Compare SHA-256 of ordered private row snapshots before and after; do not publish row content or hashes.

covers: Concurrent bootstrap preserves IDs and agent secrets.
Changed password, credential version, required password change and reduced global role remain unchanged.
Disabled owner, inactive memberships and reduced project roles/scopes remain unchanged.
Revoked and expired credentials are not renewed or reactivated.
Missing cached credentials fail without emitting new secrets or changing rows.
Production and remote origins are rejected.

limitations: Existing local data preservation and synthetic revoked/expired states were verified separately.
New administration/mobile browser flows are pending.
No volume deletion, applied migration edits, commit, push or external deployment.
Evidence is local and has not been accepted or approved in ACC.
